name: go-history
fault_schedule: Committed proxy drops first completed append response; native journal callback stages new branch and node then aborts; reopen and competing writer fence replay.
assertions: All seven history methods cross actual gRPC to the Go native owner.
Forward and reverse multipage reads return complete node/transaction sequences; metadata-only preserves ordering.
Exact-key append uses PostgreSQL upsert semantics.
New branch/tree/node abort together; acknowledged tree and nodes reopen together with durable replay.
Fork and deletion boundaries preserve ancestry guard and opaque tree information.
Lost completed append response retries unchanged identity; fenced owner cannot replay.
Bounded large-node pagination preserves continuation; append timeout types match selected SQL paths.
limitations: Memory object store only; no S3/process-crash proof.
History component only, not full ExecutionStore or Temporal boot.
GetAllHistoryTreeBranches covers configured partition; adapter routing/global fanout remains a later gate.
Pinned PostgreSQL reverse and metadata-only query defects corrected explicitly; no broad SQL parity claim.
